g.text: Rundown subcooled -161.5 degC, 215 kPa(a) at the tanks (D-005). Top or bottom fill
from AI-1102 against the tank's density profile LTD-2103 / LTD-3103 (rollover, D-007).
I-102: ZSC-1102 / -1103 both closed, PZT-1105, I-201 / I-203 or I-301 / I-303 with the other fill valve closed, I-804. UZ-1115: I-203, I-303.
XV-1115: SIS, energise-to-trip with its own air accumulator (D-017). Thermal relief BOG-1004 / -1010 / -1011 into BOG-1001.
PIC-1110 / PIC-1111: split-range tank pressure control (D-017).
FO-1117: restriction orifice limiting the make-up flow (H-04 A1).
XV-1102, XV-1103, XV-1111..1114: closure at least 30 s (speed controller, non-return valve, air accumulator); XV-1106..1109 at least 30 s;
XS-1100 trips the trains' rundown as the closure starts (C&E I-101, I-102). HS-1106..1109: last open fill branch not closed (I-103, D-030).
